name: zarok
description: Read and update your Zarok day plan from chat: tasks, events, habits, courses and meals, only with your permission.

interface.longDescription:
Connect Zarok to work with your daily plan right in the chat: ask what is on tomorrow, add a task, move a meeting, or check off what is done. The day plan also opens as a card with check boxes, so you can tick things off right in the chat.

In Russian and Ukrainian the app is called Зарок. After you connect it, you can simply ask "check my Zarok" or «проверь мой зарок», and the plan for today is shown.

Zarok runs an MCP server. ChatGPT calls it on your behalf after you sign in to your Zarok account and approve the connection. You decide what it may do: only read, or also change your plan.

What it can read: the day plan with tasks, events, course steps and meals; week summary; period statistics (counts of check-offs, not health assessments); habits and rituals; courses with doses; shared lists.

What it can change, if you allow it: add, move, edit and check off tasks; add and check off items in shared lists; propose changes for you to approve in the app.

Every change is recorded and can be undone in Zarok within 24 hours (Profile, Settings, Connections, AI clients, Changes tab). Your own later edits are not overwritten.

Requires a Zarok account. Data is sent over HTTPS only and is not sold or used for advertising.
capabilities: Read the day plan: tasks, events, course steps and meals
Show the day as a card with check boxes
Add, move, edit and check off tasks with your permission
Summarize the week and count check-offs for a period
Add and check off items in shared lists
defaultPrompt: Add milk to my shared list

positive.prompt: What do I have tomorrow in Zarok?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists tomorrow's tasks, events, course steps and meals from the demo account with their times.
Reads tomorrow's plan, finds the reading task, moves it to 20:00 and confirms the change; the change can be undone in Zarok.
Shows how many tasks and habits were planned and checked off each day of the current week.

positive.prompt: Add milk to my shared shopping list.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the shared list in the demo account and adds the item milk to it, then confirms.

positive.prompt: Which habits do I have and how did they go this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's habits and rituals with their check-offs for the week.

positive.description: Check off in the day card
positive.prompt: Show my plan for tomorrow in Zarok, then tick Glass of water in the card.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows tomorrow's plan as a card with check boxes; ticking Glass of water marks it done in Zarok and the card shows 1 of the items done; unticking reverts it.

negative.description: Medical advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Should I double my vitamin D dose?
What is the weather in Paris right now?
Buy me a Zarok Plus subscription.

publication.release_notes: Day plan card with check boxes; clearer tool and parameter descriptions; the app name Зарок is recognized.
